product.name: Palmstreet Live Shopping Platform
product.description: A live-commerce platform where sellers stream products, interact with viewers, and complete purchases through live auctions and sales.

product.name: Palmstreet Marketplace
product.description: An online marketplace with listings for collectible and specialty goods, including rare plants, aquatics, reptiles, crystals, jewelry, fashion, coins, and designer toys.

product.name: Palmstreet Seller Services
product.description: Tools and services that help merchants sell through live streams or traditional listings, manage shop operations, and process transactions with platform support.

product.name: Palmstreet Community
product.description: In-app social features that let hobbyists and collectors connect through live chats, comments, reviews, shared content, and product-focused discussions.
